record.body: R86 promotes a reusable standard-work distinction: semantic exact-subject qualification and hosted-wrapper execution are separate partial-order facts. Hosted pre-exec failure remains an Andon and cannot erase a successful exact local capsule. The repeated mfw/yawl ambiguity is returned upstream once into canonical GGEN semantics rather than retained as cognitive WIP.
